Rules (declared): anomaly = full or partial month whose share is >= 2x the median of the previous 3 months AND
>= +1.0 percentage point AND >= 50 reviews. Recurring = complaint share >= 0.5% in a month. Shares use classified
reviews that month as the denominator. Keyword series are regex matches (code), not model labels.

comparable_windows.note: Full calendar months only; shares use classified reviews in the window as the denominator. Review volume is self-selected (e.g. spikes in 2023-07 and 2023-10).

events._note: Curated EXTERNAL context from news reports, used only to annotate the timeline. Dates and descriptions come from the cited sources; a matching spike in reviews is a correlation, not proof of cause.

events.title: Home feed redesign announced (Stream On)
events.description: Spotify unveiled a vertical, TikTok-style home feed; users criticized reduced everyday usability.

events.title: Quran burnings in Sweden → calls to boycott Swedish brands
events.description: Quran-burning protests in Stockholm (June–July 2023) prompted calls to boycott Swedish goods; Spotify is Swedish.

events.title: Lyrics paywall test for free users
events.description: Spotify began testing a paywall on lyrics ('Enjoy lyrics on Spotify Premium').

events.title: Free-tier restrictions in India (no manual order, rewind, repeat)
events.description: Free users in India lost manual song ordering, rewind/scrub and repeat; reports of negative Play Store reviews.
